skill.summary: Zero-LLM feedback learning system for OpenClaw agents. Detects user feedback (emoji reactions, text signals like "переделай"/"круто"), logs events, discovers...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the feedback-learning skill.
- Provides a shell/Python-based feedback learning system for OpenClaw agents—no LLMs or API keys required.
- Detects user feedback (emoji and common Russian/English text signals), logs events, groups recurring patterns, promotes auto-learned rules, and generates weekly reports.
- Includes setup guides for installation, agent workspace integration, and scheduled reporting/analysis.
- Supports both Russian and English feedback, tracks event and pattern data, and exposes structured promotion of recurring user requests to agent rules.
